configurePresets.name: app-sim
configurePresets.description: Clickable dartboard instead of cameras. No models, no inference backend, fastest build.

configurePresets.name: app-network
configurePresets.description: Cameras and UI here, models on a server. Point it with TREBLOTRON_SERVER=host:port at runtime.

configurePresets.name: app-local-windows
configurePresets.displayName: App — single PC, cameras and DirectML on one Windows box
configurePresets.description: The simplest setup there is: three USB cameras straight into this machine, GPU inference locally, no server and no networking.

configurePresets.name: app-demo
configurePresets.displayName: App — simulated darts, release build for distribution
configurePresets.description: Same source as app-sim, built Release and stripped. This is what the downloadable demo zip is made from; use app-sim for day-to-day work.

configurePresets.name: app-local-jetson
configurePresets.description: Never built against a real TensorRT. Kept compiling so the backend does not rot, but it is not part of a release and has not been verified on hardware.

configurePresets.name: server-directml
configurePresets.displayName: Server — GPU inference via DirectML (any DX12 GPU)
configurePresets.description: Headless inference server on the local GPU. Works on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA alike. Fetches ONNX Runtime at configure time.

configurePresets.name: server-cpu
configurePresets.description: Headless inference server. No SDL, no flecs, no games — builds only debug/dart/detect/net/server plus a trimmed OpenCV.
